children.game_version: simplified playful mimicry of bull and milkmaid roles

seniors.counts: simplified counts focusing on basic sway
seniors.tempo_and_range: reduced tempo and limited waist movement

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: gestures to mimic bullfighting and to distract bulls
movement_profile.formation_and_space: group formations with characters interacting dynamically
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: women move waists side to side despite heavy skirts
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: includes jumps by kusillos and agile movements by bull dancers
movement_profile.posture: upright with active waist movement for women; agile and dynamic for men

signature_moves.description: Women sway waists side to side rhythmically under many skirts
signature_moves.name: Waist sway

signature_moves.description: Men carrying bull costumes simulate charging movements
signature_moves.name: Bull charge

signature_moves.description: Young dancers jump energetically to entertain
signature_moves.name: Kusillo jumps

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: disrespecting the satirical nature damaging heavy skirts unsafe jumps

music_profile.sound_description: Music combines brass and traditional Andean instruments with rhythmic bell sounds from bulls, creating a festive and satirical atmosphere.

basic_steps: Women move waists side to side rhythmically
Men simulate bull charges carrying bull costumes
Kusillos jump and move playfully among dancers
Lecheras distract bulls with hand gestures and containers
teaching.formation: group dance with characters moving dynamically in open space
teaching.level_notes: beginners start by learning waist movements and simple steps; advanced dancers perform jumps and character interactions
